messages:
jamie (infra_oncall): getting alerts — multiple gpu nodes in cluster-a showing OOM + CUDA illegal memory access, containers restarting :warning:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: gpu-illegal-memaccess-surge - Sev2 - runbook linked /runbooks/gpu-illegal.json
jamie (infra_oncall): marking impacted pool: serving-prod-gpu, starting cordon + drain on node-a12 to stop noisy restarts
maria (serving_sre): seeing same in logs, stack trace includes 'CUDA illegal memory access' around model forward, 2 containers per node failing
raj (runtime_eng): can you paste kernel logs? I want the exact traceback and kernel oops if present
jamie (infra_oncall): paste logs:
```
[2026-03-17T14:12:03Z] container: inference-service-xyz terminated: signal 11 (SIGSEGV)
[2026-03-17T14:12:03Z] runtime: cudaCheckError: CUDART:77 (illegal memory access)
[2026-03-17T14:12:03Z] stack: at aten::embedding... at model.cpp:412
```
jamie (infra_oncall): also seeing OOM killers firing on two nodes before the CUDA error in some cases
maria (serving_sre): hypothesis: concurrent eviction under memory pressure causing stale KV cache pointers? Raj, could the runtime free a buffer while another thread accesses it?
raj (runtime_eng): possible. We recently merged the async batcher change that touches KV cache lifecycle. Reverting that patch to test is quick.
olivia (cust_success): heads-up — two customers reported increased error rate and elevated latency spikes starting ~14:10 UTC. One is on a latency SLA. I told them we're investigating.
jamie (infra_oncall): rolling revert on canary pool now: `kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=3`
deploy-bot: rollout undo started for deployment/inference-runtime in namespace serving (canary)
maria (serving_sre): canary logs showing immediate reduction in CUDA illegal messages after undo, but some nodes still have crashes (maybe persistent corrupted pages)
raj (runtime_eng): ordering: I'll disable async batcher entirely on the affected nodes and redeploy a build with additional runtime checks (bounds checks on KV pointers). Preparing patch.
olivia (cust_success): sending proactive note to impacted customers: short blurb + ETA for mitigation. Also ask if they can route non-critical traffic to backup region.
jamie (infra_oncall): cordon+drain done for node-a12 and node-a15. Scaling up cold CPU-only replicas to reduce pressure: `replicas=+6` on inference-fallback-cpu
maria (serving_sre): added temporary model fallback policy for the routing layer to prefer quantized models (lower memory) in pool=serving-prod-gpu
raj (runtime_eng): pushed instrumented runtime to canary nodes: increased logging around KV alloc/free and added `CHECK(kv_index >=0 && kv_index < cache_size)` lines, will watch for violations
incident-bot: CPU fallback activated, traffic shifted: 18% -> cpu-fallback, 82% -> gpu
jamie (infra_oncall): still seeing 1 node with repeated illegal memaccess after drain, might be hardware-level page corruption. Rebooting node-a20 now.
maria (serving_sre): after reboot node-a20 came back healthy, no more crashes on that host. Suspect transient SMMU/pagetable garbage under heavy eviction
raj (runtime_eng): logs from instrumented runtime show a single CHECK failure: `kv_index out of range` before free. This matches a race where an evicting thread and a serving thread access same slot.
raj (runtime_eng): pushing hotfix: lightweight mutex around KV slot free and a short grace-period mark bit instead of immediate free. Will deploy to canary then rollout if green.
maria (serving_sre): recommend keeping cordon on original noisy nodes until we confirm hotfix; also schedule kernel oops dump for one node for postmortem
olivia (cust_success): emailed affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA ~45m, offered credit if SLA breached. They appreciate the proactive update.
jamie (infra_oncall): monitoring: error rate down 70% since revert + hotfix canary. No new OOM spikes after scaling cpu fallback.
raj (runtime_eng): hotfix passed canary, rolling to remaining GPU pools with maxUnavailable=1. Deploy sequence started.
deploy-bot: rollout started: inference-runtime-hotfix across 18 nodes, maxUnavailable=1
maria (serving_sre): keeping incident open until 2 hours of stable metrics post-rollout. Creating follow-up action: add static bounds checks in core allocator and add more deterministic eviction tests in CI
olivia (cust_success): follow-up: customers acknowledged, one requested postmortem once we have RCA
jamie (infra_oncall): incident update: severity reduced to Sev3, continuing to observe. Thanks team for quick coord. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity->Sev3, channels: incidents+eng-runtime+cust-success, postmortem required (72h)
raj (runtime_eng): preemptive action item: revert async batcher baseline until exhaustive stress tests are added. I'll open PR for rollback + tests now
maria (serving_sre): noted. I'll add runbook step to throttle evictions under memory pressure as a temporary control
olivia (cust_success): closing loop with customers once postmortem timeline is set
jamie (infra_oncall): thanks everyone. I'll leave cordon on nodes until metrics show 2h stable.
